image_description: An outdoor wooden staircase attached to the side of a house with white siding. The stairs lead up to a landing or deck area, bordered by a wooden railing system (bannister) on the right and the house wall on the left. The background features dense green foliage and trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Vertical railing system following staircase geometry creating diagonal linear pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The railing clearly follows the incline of the stairs, creating a distinct diagonal line from bottom-left to top-right.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Continuous handrail supported by evenly spaced balusters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A continuous wooden handrail is visible, supported by vertical metal balusters that appear evenly spaced.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Balusters are slender cylindrical or turned posts of narrow diameter, closely spaced relative to their height.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The balusters are thin, dark metal rods, significantly narrower than the handrail and newel posts, fitting the description of slender posts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Handrail is smooth rounded or molded strip running parallel to staircase incline.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The handrail appears to be a standard rounded wooden profile, running parallel to the stair nosing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Newel posts thicker vertical supports anchor ends and corners.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a thick wooden post at the bottom start of the railing and another at the top landing, acting as anchors/newel posts.
The entire railing structure aligns perfectly with the angle of the steps.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Materials range from polished wood with ornate turnings to sleek metal with minimal design.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows a combination of stained wood (handrail/newels) and sleek, minimal metal balusters.
Visual textures confirm wood grain on the rails/posts and metallic sheen on the balusters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Evenly spaced vertical posts creating rhythmic pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The spacing between the metal balusters is consistent, creating a regular visual rhythm.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural classification of the railing system against ImageNet taxonomy.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the stairs and ensure the railing does not merge incorrectly with the background foliage or house wall.
To check for fusion artifacts where the thin metal balusters meet the handrail and stair treads, a common failure point in AI generation.
To assess lighting consistency, shadow casting from the railing onto the steps, and general image coherence.

focus_areas: Connection points between balusters and handrail/treads for fusion/melting.
Consistency of baluster spacing and thickness.
Shadow alignment of the railing on the stair treads.
Structural plausibility of the newel post anchoring.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the base of the metal balusters. In AI images, these often fail to connect cleanly to the stair stringer or treads, appearing to float or melt into the wood. Also, verify that the perspective of the railing matches the perspective of the house siding on the left.
